rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Half a Beat Late
card.instruction: Use the group’s reactions as your cue, joining each one a moment late and escalating your enthusiasm to stay included.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Everyone gasped at your dragon eating the shed? Oh! OH! That was our best shed!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're cheering now. It spat out Dad's wedding ring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hooray! HOORAY! Shall I start a collection for its dinner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're whispering. Dad's proposing again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, yes. Quiet. I'll hold everyone's coats so not one sleeve rustles.

card.title: Half a Beat Late
card.instruction: Use the group’s reactions as your cue, joining each one a moment late and escalating your enthusiasm to stay included.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You all laughed at the headmaster's face in that mirror? Ha! HA! Best staff party ever!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've stopped. He's trapped inside. Everyone's calling for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help! HELP! I'll call the fire brigade and the mirror shop!

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The caretaker's opening the back. We're thanking her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you! THANK YOU! I'll nominate you for caretaker of the year!

card.title: I Predicted This
card.instruction: Create opportunities to show that each impossible event confirms a theory you understood long before anyone asked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cupboard spoke! Fetch my prediction: 'Storage will develop a voice.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need plates, not your notebook.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask it politely. I've maintained for years that neglected furniture demands recognition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It wants its name on the dinner invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly: recognition. Put it beside me; I can explain how long I've expected this.

card.title: I Predicted This
card.instruction: Create opportunities to show that each impossible event confirms a theory you understood long before anyone asked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dog's floating. My old notebook predicted household things would rise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says bread. Help me get him down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bread was the first case. My theory always included pets. Try 'sit.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He sat on the ceiling. Now the cat's joining him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Independent confirmation! Bring the notebook; you'll want the chapter on getting them down.

card.title: The Ceremony Requires More
card.instruction: Treat every ordinary step as only the beginning of an elaborate ceremony, adding necessary details whenever anyone tries to finish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you blow out your birthday candle, we need a witness candle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can that be the last one? The ice cream's melting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, once we acknowledge its service.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say thank you. Then we eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Light the acknowledgement candle so everyone can see you thanking it.

card.title: The Ceremony Requires More
card.instruction: Treat every ordinary step as only the beginning of an elaborate ceremony, adding necessary details whenever anyone tries to finish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shoelace is tied. Now we bless the successful tying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bus is here. I'm finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The knot is finished. The departure requires a second knot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, I've double-knotted it. Can I go?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After we formally introduce the two knots. They'll be travelling together.

card.title: Reality Is Coming Apart
card.instruction: Treat each contradiction, coincidence, and ordinary mistake as evidence that reality is losing structural integrity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's a missing letter in this notice. Reality's losing components.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a typo.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Today a letter. Tomorrow the word floor stops holding us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll correct it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use permanent ink. We need structural reinforcement.

card.title: Reality Is Coming Apart
card.instruction: Treat each contradiction, coincidence, and ordinary mistake as evidence that reality is losing structural integrity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've said 'the rent's due' twice. Time's slipping in this flat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you didn't hear me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sound's failing too. We should tell the landlord.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I am the landlord. Shall I write it down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. Date it, so we'll know whether tomorrow still arrives.

card.title: Wonderful, It’s Impossible
card.instruction: Celebrate every impossible development as a breakthrough that removes old limitations and creates exciting new problems.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The kettle's floating! Tea no longer needs a table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's escaping upstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Direct delivery. A second breakthrough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't reach it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally, a reason to use the ladder indoors.

card.title: Wonderful, It’s Impossible
card.instruction: Celebrate every impossible development as a breakthrough that removes old limitations and creates exciting new problems.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our guest floated through the wall! Wonderful, the door queue is obsolete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She left a hole in the plaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A second entrance! Invite the neighbours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Rain's coming through. We'll need umbrellas at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Indoor umbrella seating! Finally, a seating plan with altitude. I'll move the chandelier.

card.title: Fine, What Does It Eat?
card.instruction: Accept the impossible premise immediately, then focus on its schedule, appetite, cleanup, safety, and long-term maintenance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, a dragon in the kitchen. Dry food or wet?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It eats treasure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do supermarkets sell that in bulk?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It also breathes fire.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Heating savings may cover the food bill.

card.title: Fine, What Does It Eat?
card.instruction: Accept the impossible premise immediately, then focus on its schedule, appetite, cleanup, safety, and long-term maintenance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The invisible guest can stay. Who takes the first feeding shift?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's immortal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then weekend cover matters indefinitely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't know if it eats.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Label the leftovers. We'll establish a baseline.

card.title: The Third Detail Matters
card.instruction: Choose one arbitrary detail and treat it as the key that explains, controls, or prevents the entire impossible situation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that pebble level. It's the only thing holding Tuesday here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's an ordinary pebble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly why Tuesday trusts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I put it down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On a level surface. Wednesday's waiting for a mistake.

card.title: The Third Detail Matters
card.instruction: Choose one arbitrary detail and treat it as the key that explains, controls, or prevents the entire impossible situation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't press the kettle's third button. That tiny scratch on it is keeping the moon lit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the boil button. I want tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use a saucepan. We can't risk smoothing the scratch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll press it with my fingernail, around the scratch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me guide your hand. Everyone reading by moonlight is relying on this cup.

card.title: The Universe Is Rhyming
card.instruction: Treat repeated shapes, phrases, and coincidences as links between unrelated events until they form one grand and unquestionable message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three coffee rings, three visitors. The universe has brought us together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all ordered coffee. I only came to return your keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On a ring! You're returning to the circle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The door just squeaked three times. Shall I oil it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After we invite the third neighbour. Three voices, three rings: this house must reunite everyone.

card.title: The Universe Is Rhyming
card.instruction: Treat repeated shapes, phrases, and coincidences as links between unrelated events until they form one grand and unquestionable message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said 'wait' as these station scales showed my weight. We're being told to stay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're late. Our train's on platform four.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Four, and this ticket says 'for two.' The message concerns both of us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then come on. It's going to Hope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course! Wait for hope. This journey is a test of faith; we're staying right here.

card.title: Order of Business
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the person who decides what happens in what order. Redirect every interruption into the approved sequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we discuss the kitchen fire, may I approve last week's minutes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The minutes are in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must establish whether anyone remembers them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember voting to replace the extinguisher.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can begin with matters arising.

card.title: Order of Business
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the person who decides what happens in what order. Redirect every interruption into the approved sequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wedding speeches go father, mother, best man, bride.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bride needs to say the groom hasn't arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That information belongs in her speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me to announce it now. The guests are leaving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have her father announce that her mother will introduce you. We can shorten the gaps.

card.title: Authority on Paper
card.instruction: Project firm control through titles and procedure, then tighten the formalities whenever anyone tests whether your position has real support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As acting manager, I'm authorising everyone to stay late.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who appointed you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That question needs to be submitted on company stationery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You printed this stationery this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I've already established a proper channel for challenging it.

card.title: Authority on Paper
card.instruction: Project firm control through titles and procedure, then tighten the formalities whenever anyone tests whether your position has real support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm chairing this meeting under the emergency neighbourhood charter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are only two of us, and I haven't agreed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll record your objection before proceeding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Proceeding to what?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A vote to recognise my authority to record objections.

transfer.action: I watch your face before applauding the strange behaviour of {prop}.
transfer.opening: Yes! Exactly the reaction I was about to have. {request}
transfer.response: Show me which direction we're all celebrating. {counter}
transfer.closing: Of course. I was demonstrating the response we've wisely avoided.

transfer.action: I uncover a suspiciously fresh prediction beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: As forecast: a significant change in ordinary things. {request}
transfer.response: Read the broad wording as professional foresight. {counter}
transfer.closing: Exactly. I had allowed for an exceptionally comprehensive range of miracles.

transfer.action: I put a witness candle beside {prop}, then a second for the first.
transfer.opening: We can't finish until we bless the finishing. {request}
transfer.response: The final step needs its own concluding step. {counter}
transfer.challenge: Can this be the last one?
transfer.closing: After we perform the small ceremony that declares it last.

transfer.action: I draw a crack in reality around the smallest error near {prop}.
transfer.opening: It started with a typo. Now the universe is slipping. {request}
transfer.response: That repetition could be time skipping again. {counter}
transfer.closing: With a perfectly intact response in a rapidly fraying reality.

transfer.action: I applaud as {prop} floats above the table.
transfer.response: Think how much table space this frees. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then we've discovered something more powerful than the first opportunity.

transfer.action: I label the creature's feeding schedule beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Fine, a dragon. Dry food or wet? {request}
transfer.response: Eternal beings still need weekend cover. {counter}
transfer.challenge: How can you be so calm?
transfer.closing: I'm not calm until someone takes the Sunday feeding shift.

transfer.action: I guard the tiny third button beside {prop} with both hands.
transfer.opening: That button is holding Tuesday in place. {request}
transfer.response: The larger controls don't matter. This one does. {counter}
transfer.closing: Exactly why someone has to recognize its extraordinary responsibility.

transfer.action: I trace matching shapes around {prop} and echo the door's rhythm.
transfer.opening: Three circles, three knocks. The universe is composing. {request}
transfer.response: Listen for where the pattern repeats next. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then it's been rehearsing this line before either of us arrived.

transfer.action: I move the request about {prop} down to item seven on the agenda.
transfer.response: Your interruption now has a numbered place. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then introduce yourself in the urgent-but-approved format.

transfer.action: I place {prop} beneath my unsigned acting-director notice.
transfer.opening: The letterhead settles this for now. {request}
transfer.response: Properly headed instructions are still instructions. {counter}
transfer.closing: The counter-signature should catch up with the authority already printed.
